title: Tempo Run Effort with Strength Integration - 45km Race Prep

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Flow smoothly between positions, synchronize breath with movement, warm up spine and core

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the rotation, maintain upright posture, open hips dynamically on each side

items.name: Air Bike - Easy Pace
items.cues: Build heart rate gradually, light resistance, find rhythm for transition to main workout

items.name: Air Bike - Tempo Effort
items.cues: Maintain RPE 7-8 throughout. Steady cadence around 90-100 rpm. This is challenging but sustainable pace. Focus on consistent effort matching race-pace demands for the 45km Engelbrektsloppet. Sit tall, engage core, smooth pedal stroke.

items.name: Ab Wheel
items.cues: Control the rollout and return. Engage core maximally. Move with intention. Maintain neutral spine alignment throughout. This strengthens the anterior core critical for endurance racing.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Slow, controlled movements. Extend opposite arm and leg fully. Hold briefly. Focus on stability and balance. Breathing steady.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side 45 seconds. Keep heel down, lean forward gently. Calf recovery is important after tempo effort.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm against wall at shoulder height. Step forward gently to feel stretch. Hold 45 seconds each side. Release tension in upper body.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, gentle flow. Allow spine to decompress after intense effort. Breathing drives the movement. Full restoration of mobility.

rationale: Tempo workout at RPE 7-8 directly trains the lactate threshold and aerobic capacity needed for a 45km race in 20 days. Air Bike provides controlled tempo stimulus while reducing impact stress.

Recent training shows 3 consecutive endurance sessions; this tempo effort maintains aerobic focus while integrating targeted strength work (Ab Wheel) to reinforce core stability critical for ultra-distance running/racing performance.

Duration of 50 minutes matches target exactly, with 32 minutes at tempo pace supplemented by mobility prep and focused core strengthening with active recovery to support the demanding 45km event goal.
